Send the full build brief after a fresh resolve-only session

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. When `forge work --note` answers a worker question and the default merge conflicts, this brief drops both `note` and `question`. The command already marks the question answered at worker.py:147–149, and successful handback clears it at native.py:274–276. The next normal round receives neither the answer nor its coordinator-note commit, because its change summary starts from the completed resolution round's HEAD. Automatically generated stop-choice guidance at worker.py:199–209 is similarly consumed when the round counter advances. Preserve these deferred instructions and deliver them in the next normal build brief.
findings.title: Preserve coordinator answers through resolve-only rounds

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. If a fresh or replacement worker session starts with a conflict, its only initial brief is the resolve-only prompt. After resolution, the session remains resumable, so this call selects the continued brief. `_brief` at worker.py:552–577 says the earlier brief still applies and omits the Done-when requirements and standards; for fixes it also omits the full task description. Consequently, the worker resumes building without ever receiving its build contract. Track whether the session has received a normal brief and send the full brief on its first normal round after resolution.
findings.title: Send the full build brief after a fresh resolve-only session

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. The refresh runs after `config`, worker family, routing, readiness and model selection have already been computed at worker.py:99–141. When another settings fix changes workers or models on the default branch, the merge updates `forge.toml`, but native handouts and Claude SDK rounds still use the old selections. Native handouts explicitly override the updated role model with that stale selection at native.py:149. A removed worker can also fail readiness before the refresh is reached. Refresh before worker selection, or recompute configuration, routing and readiness after the merge.
findings.title: Select the worker using the settings brought in by the merge
